name: cyberspace chain rules golden vectors
revision_note: 2026-10-08-residue-openings (CYBERSPACE_V2.md 8.12): everything in 2026-09-28-virtual-brackets with the rulings folded in on 2026-10-07 and in two rounds on 2026-10-08 (CYBERSPACE_V2.md 8.12): the first round clarified forks, signatures, sector tags and regions; the second made a fork fatal, made any A tag equal to spawn a spawn, made a spawn never a link, required every tag the chain rules read exactly once with a well-formed value, and fixed the network for chain validity as Bitcoin mainnet, always, so a net tag is never read (DECK-0001 1.4); with hop proofs of version 2, residue openings (5.9 to 5.13): every hop carries the seal in proof and its mn and mp tags, each read exactly once and checked at Level 1 (8.4, 8.7.1, 8.8), and a version 1 hop is invalid unless its id is listed in grandfathered-v1-hops.txt

test_key.derivation: sha256(CYBERSPACE_CHAIN_VECTORS_KEY || be32(101)), the first j whose spawn coordinate has terrain K <= 3

line.description: Synthetic stops 0..7, all ports (plane bit 1), so each stop coordinate is its merkle root. Block hashes are the spec reference's stand-in (decks/hyperjump-reference.py). Stop 2 is the station for an as_of bound of 2 to 5 and stop 6 for 6 or 7.

grandfathered_v1_hops.description: The test list: when the vectors run, a verifier uses these ids in place of grandfathered-v1-hops.txt, and at no other time. Each is a version 1 hop signed by the test key, which no real list contains.

reasons.no-spawn: no authentic spawn event for this pubkey, so there is no chain (8.7.3 rule 1)
reasons.fork: two or more events whose e genesis names the newest spawn name the same event as e previous (each event's first e previous tag); the chain is invalid from the spawn, whatever the forking events are and whichever is valid or earlier (8.7.3)
reasons.a-tag: the event carries no A tag, more than one, or one with no value or an empty value; a bare ["A"] counts as an A tag (8.8)
reasons.malformed: a tag a chain rule reads is missing, repeated, valueless or ill-formed. Each of these must appear exactly once: e genesis and e previous on every event but the spawn (32-byte lowercase hex); e entry on an exit-virtual (32-byte lowercase hex); C on every recognized action and c on every recognized action but the exit-virtual (32-byte lowercase hex); proof on a hop, sidestep, enter-hyperspace or hyperjump (32-byte lowercase hex); mr (three colon-joined 32-byte lowercase hex roots), mp (non-empty) and hx, hy and hz (base-10) on a sidestep; from_height and B (base-10) and mp (non-empty) on a hyperjump; as_of (base-10) on the first ride after boarding, when it is present at all. mn (16 lowercase hex characters) and mp (lowercase hex of exactly 16 x (128 + 64 x depth) characters, the depth that the hop's c, C and e previous give it, 8.4) on a hop, and mn (16 lowercase hex characters) on a sidestep or hyperjump, may be absent (5.13, 6.16, DECK-0001 5.8) but not repeated
reasons.sector-tags: a recognized action's X, Y, Z or S tag is missing, repeated (a valueless copy counts), or not the value computed from its C (10)
reasons.spawn-coordinate: the spawn's C is not its pubkey (8.3)
reasons.c-mismatch: c is not the C of the nearest recognized action before it (8.9 item 2, continuity)
reasons.hop-proof: the hop does not verify at Level 1 (8.7.1, 5.11): its price or its openings, or it lacks mn or mp; or it is a version 1 hop (no mn and no mp) whose id is not listed in grandfathered-v1-hops.txt (5.13)
reasons.sidestep-proof: the sidestep does not verify at Level 1 (8.7.2): its geometry, the values of its height tags, its openings, its price, or a missing mn on an unlisted sidestep (6.16)
reasons.enter-hyperspace-moved: an enter-hyperspace's C is not its c (DECK-0001 3.1)
reasons.enter-hyperspace-proof: the entry proof does not verify (DECK-0001 3.2)
reasons.hyperjump-predecessor: the action a hyperjump looks back to is neither enter-hyperspace nor hyperjump (DECK-0001 4.3)
reasons.hyperjump-zero-length: a ride whose B equals its from_height; there is no zero-length ride (DECK-0001 5.2, 5.6)
reasons.hyperjump-as-of: the first ride after boarding has no as_of tag, or its as_of is not a height on the line, or is below B (DECK-0001 4.2, 4.3)
reasons.hyperjump-station: the first ride after boarding does not depart from the station (DECK-0001 4.2, 4.3)
reasons.hyperjump-from-height: a later ride does not depart from the previous ride's B (DECK-0001 4.3)
reasons.hyperjump-stop: the ride's C is not the stop coordinate of B, or B is not a height on the line (DECK-0001 5.5 Level 1 step 2)
reasons.hyperjump-proof: the ride's proof does not verify at Level 1 (DECK-0001 5.5, 5.8): openings that do not decode or do not reach the root, the price, or a missing mn on an unlisted ride
reasons.enter-virtual-moved: an enter-virtual's C is not its c; entering a game does not move the identity (8.11.1)
reasons.region: the enter-virtual's region tag is missing, repeated (a valueless copy counts) or ill-formed: H not canonical in [0, 85], or the base not aligned (8.11.1)
reasons.game-tag: the enter-virtual does not carry exactly one p tag marked game holding a 32-byte lowercase hex pubkey (8.11.1)
reasons.base-action-in-bracket: an action of the base protocol or of a mandatory DECK inside an open bracket (8.11.4 rule 3)
reasons.exit-without-bracket: an exit-virtual when no bracket is open (8.11.4 rule 6)
reasons.exit-wrong-entry: an exit-virtual whose e entry names anything but the open enter-virtual (8.11.4 rule 6)
reasons.exit-position: an exit-virtual whose C is not the c of its enter-virtual (8.11.4 rule 2)

vectors.name: spawn-only
vectors.description: A spawn alone is a valid chain; the position is the spawn coordinate, the pubkey.

vectors.name: spawn-coordinate-not-pubkey
vectors.description: A spawn whose C is not its pubkey is invalid; with no valid event, the identity stands at its spawn coordinate.

vectors.name: spawn-sector-tags-wrong
vectors.description: A spawn whose sector tags are computed from another coordinate is invalid.

vectors.name: spawn-newest-invalid-no-fallback
vectors.description: The newest spawn is invalid. It still starts the active chain, the reader does not fall back to the older spawn and its valid hop, and the identity stands at its spawn coordinate.

vectors.name: no-spawn
vectors.description: Events with no spawn among them resolve to no chain.

vectors.name: fork-both-valid-dead
vectors.description: Two valid hops name the spawn as previous, one with a valid descendant. A fork is fatal whichever branch is valid or earlier: the chain is invalid from the spawn and the identity stands at its spawn coordinate. Events are listed out of order on purpose.

vectors.name: fork-same-created-at-dead
vectors.description: Two branches with the same created_at: a fork, so the chain is dead; no tie-break applies.

vectors.name: fork-invalid-and-valid-dead
vectors.description: One branch has an invalid proof and the other is valid. The fork is found from the links before any proof is checked, so the reason is the fork, and the chain is dead at the spawn coordinate.

vectors.name: fork-deep-in-history-dead
vectors.description: Five valid hops, then two hops that both name the fifth. The fork is fatal however much valid travel came before it: the chain is invalid from the spawn and the identity stands at its spawn coordinate, not at the fifth hop.

vectors.name: fork-skipped-and-hop-dead
vectors.description: A skipped action and a hop both name the same event as previous. A skipped action is still a link, so this is a fork and the chain is dead.

vectors.name: fork-virtual-actions-dead
vectors.description: Two virtual actions inside a bracket both name the entry as previous. The bracket is opaque, but its links are not: a fork, and the chain is dead.

vectors.name: respawn-newest-spawn
vectors.description: The newest spawn starts the active chain. An event whose e genesis names the older spawn is ignored even though its e previous names the newest spawn.

vectors.name: forged-copy-ignored
vectors.description: A copy of a real event with its content altered keeps the real id and sig, but the id is not its hash: it is discarded before resolving, whichever copy a relay returns first.

vectors.name: forged-fork-ignored
vectors.description: An event whose id is not its hash names the spawn as previous with an earlier created_at than the real hop. It is discarded, so there is no fork and the chain is valid: a forged event cannot kill a chain.

vectors.name: unsigned-fork-ignored
vectors.description: A hop with a correct id and a valid proof whose sig signs a different id, signed earlier than the real hop. It is not authentic and is discarded, so there is no fork and the real hop continues the chain.

vectors.name: other-author-ignored
vectors.description: A validly signed event by another pubkey names this spawn as previous, signed earlier than the real hop. Its pubkey is not the identity's, so it is discarded and makes no fork. Verify with the test key's pubkey as the identity.

vectors.name: forged-event-cuts-branch
spec: 8.7.3 a branch through a discarded event is cut off
vectors.description: An inauthentic event names the head as previous, and an authentic event names the inauthentic one. The inauthentic event never existed, so the branch is cut off and the head is the event before it; the chain is valid.

vectors.name: cut-off-then-continue
spec: 8.7.3 a branch through a discarded event is cut off
vectors.description: After a cut-off branch the identity continues from the head: its next action names the head as previous and is not a fork, because the cut-off events count for nothing.

vectors.name: a-tag-two-on-hop
vectors.description: A hop with two A tags is invalid.

vectors.name: a-tag-missing
vectors.description: An event with no A tag is invalid, not skipped.

vectors.name: a-tag-two-on-skipped
vectors.description: An unrecognized action with two A tags is invalid, not skipped.

vectors.name: hop-proof-wrong-seed
vectors.description: A hop whose proof is seeded by an id other than its e previous is invalid.

vectors.name: frozen-after-invalid
vectors.description: A valid hop after an invalid one does not move the identity: the chain is frozen at its last valid position.

vectors.name: hop-c-mismatch
vectors.description: A hop whose c is not the previous C is invalid.

vectors.name: sidestep-proof-wrong-seed
vectors.description: A sidestep after a skipped action whose trees and proof were seeded by the spawn instead of the skipped action is invalid.

vectors.name: hop-sector-tags-missing
vectors.description: A hop without its S tag is invalid.

vectors.name: hop-sector-tags-duplicated
vectors.description: A hop with its X tag twice is invalid.

vectors.name: hop-sector-tags-wrong
vectors.description: A hop with a Y tag one sector off is invalid.

vectors.name: hop-sector-tags-noncanonical
vectors.description: A hop with a leading zero on X is invalid.

vectors.name: sidestep-sector-tags-missing
vectors.description: A sidestep without its Z tag is invalid.

vectors.name: skip-unknown-nonmoving-then-hop
vectors.description: An unrecognized action that does not move is skipped; the hop after it starts from the carried position and its proof is seeded by the skipped action's id.

vectors.name: skip-checks-nothing-else
spec: 8.9 what a skipped action is checked for
vectors.description: A skipped action is checked only for being authentic, linked and carrying one A tag: one with no c, no C and a malformed sector tag is still skipped.

vectors.name: skip-hop-seeded-by-nearest-recognized
vectors.description: Work is seeded by the actual previous event. A hop after a skipped action whose proof was seeded by the nearest recognized action (the spawn) instead is invalid.

vectors.name: skip-then-sidestep
vectors.description: A sidestep after a skipped action is seeded by the skipped id and fully checked.

vectors.name: skip-unknown-moving-then-hop-from-moved
vectors.description: An unrecognized action that changes the position is skipped, so the hop after it, starting where the skipped action left off, has a c that is not the carried position: the chain is invalid from the hop.

vectors.name: skip-unknown-moving-then-hop-from-carried
vectors.description: A hop after a skipped moving action is valid when its c is the carried position (the C of the nearest recognized action), since the skipped action is treated as if it were not on the chain.

vectors.name: skip-chain-ends-on-unknown
vectors.description: A chain that ends on skipped actions is valid; the position is the C of the last recognized action, and the head is the last skipped event.

vectors.name: skip-invalid-after-skipped
vectors.description: When the last valid event is a skipped action, the last valid position is the C of the last recognized action.

vectors.name: skip-then-bracket
vectors.description: An enter-virtual after a skipped action starts from the carried position.

vectors.name: bracket-valid-then-hop
vectors.description: Enter (C repeats c), two virtual actions with names and tags of the game's choosing, exit back to the base position, then a hop from it seeded by the exit's id.

vectors.name: bracket-position-held
vectors.description: After the exit the position is the entry's c, wherever the game moved.

vectors.name: bracket-empty
vectors.description: An exit straight after its entry: e previous and e entry both name the entry.

vectors.name: bracket-unclosed
vectors.description: A chain may end inside a bracket; the position is the open entry's c.

vectors.name: bracket-region-elsewhere
vectors.description: The base position need not lie in or near the declared region: an identity can play a game without traveling to it.

vectors.name: bracket-game-events-unchecked
vectors.description: The inside of a bracket belongs to the game. Virtual actions with no coordinates, malformed ones, ones far outside the region or on another plane, and missing, wrong or repeated sector tags are all valid.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-c-missing
vectors.description: An exit without a c tag is valid; its c is optional.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-c-unchecked
vectors.description: An exit whose c is neither the previous event's C nor anything else in particular is valid; its c is not checked.

vectors.name: bracket-enter-moves
vectors.description: An enter-virtual whose C is not its c is invalid: entering a game does not move the identity.

vectors.name: bracket-entry-c-mismatch
vectors.description: An entry's c is the carried position.

vectors.name: bracket-enter-sector-tags-wrong
vectors.description: An enter-virtual's sector tags are computed from its C, the base position.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-sector-tags-missing
vectors.description: An exit-virtual without its X tag is invalid.

vectors.name: bracket-hop-inside
vectors.description: A hop inside an open bracket is invalid, even when it is valid on its own: the name is reserved. Brackets do not nest.

vectors.name: bracket-enter-hyperspace-inside
vectors.description: A enter-hyperspace inside an open bracket is invalid, even when it is valid on its own: the name is reserved. Brackets do not nest.

vectors.name: bracket-enter-virtual-inside
vectors.description: A enter-virtual inside an open bracket is invalid, even when it is valid on its own: the name is reserved. Brackets do not nest.

vectors.name: bracket-sidestep-inside
vectors.description: A sidestep inside an open bracket is invalid, even when it is valid on its own: the name is reserved. Brackets do not nest.

vectors.name: bracket-hyperjump-inside
vectors.description: A hyperjump inside an open bracket is invalid.

vectors.name: bracket-virtual-two-a-tags
vectors.description: A virtual action with two A tags is invalid; inside a bracket the last valid position is the base position.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-position-mismatch
vectors.description: An exit whose C is not the entry's c is invalid.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-without-bracket
vectors.description: An exit with no bracket open is invalid.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-twice
vectors.description: A second exit naming a bracket that is already closed: no bracket is open.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-wrong-entry
vectors.description: An exit whose e entry names an earlier, closed bracket instead of the open one is invalid.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-missing-entry-tag
vectors.description: An exit without an e entry tag is malformed.

vectors.name: bracket-game-tag-missing
vectors.description: An enter-virtual must carry exactly one p tag marked game holding a 32-byte lowercase hex pubkey.

vectors.name: bracket-game-tag-duplicated
vectors.description: An enter-virtual must carry exactly one p tag marked game holding a 32-byte lowercase hex pubkey.

vectors.name: bracket-game-tag-unmarked
vectors.description: An enter-virtual must carry exactly one p tag marked game holding a 32-byte lowercase hex pubkey.

vectors.name: bracket-game-tag-bad-pubkey
vectors.description: An enter-virtual must carry exactly one p tag marked game holding a 32-byte lowercase hex pubkey.

vectors.name: bracket-game-tag-with-other-p
vectors.description: Other p tags are not game tags; one marked game is exactly one.

vectors.name: bracket-region-unaligned
vectors.description: The region tag must be present once, with H a canonical decimal in [0, 85] and the base aligned to H.

vectors.name: bracket-region-noncanonical-height
vectors.description: The region tag must be present once, with H a canonical decimal in [0, 85] and the base aligned to H.

vectors.name: bracket-region-height-above-85
vectors.description: The region tag must be present once, with H a canonical decimal in [0, 85] and the base aligned to H.

vectors.name: bracket-region-missing
vectors.description: The region tag must be present once, with H a canonical decimal in [0, 85] and the base aligned to H.

vectors.name: bracket-spawn-inside
vectors.description: A spawn while a bracket is open is a respawn, not a virtual action: it starts a new chain and the open bracket stays in the old chain's history.

vectors.name: ride-valid
vectors.description: Board, ride from the station (stop 2 within the bound 5) to stop 4, ride on to stop 3, exit by a hop.

vectors.name: ride-out-and-back-to-station
vectors.description: To stand at its own station an identity rides to a different stop and back: two rides, each passing a block.

vectors.name: ride-as-of-selects-station
vectors.description: With the bound 7 the nearest stop is 6, which is newer than the destination 4: the ride departs from 6.

vectors.name: ride-not-from-station
vectors.description: With the bound 7 the station is stop 6, so a first ride from stop 2 is invalid.

vectors.name: ride-zero-length-first
vectors.description: A first ride from the station to the station itself, in the shape the earlier draft defined, is invalid: there is no zero-length ride.

vectors.name: ride-zero-length-later
vectors.description: A later ride with from_height equal to B is invalid.

vectors.name: ride-after-hop
vectors.description: A hyperjump whose previous action is a hop is invalid.

vectors.name: ride-missing-as-of
vectors.description: The first ride after boarding must carry as_of.

vectors.name: ride-as-of-below-destination
vectors.description: as_of must be at least B.

vectors.name: ride-as-of-beyond-tip
vectors.description: as_of must be a height that exists; the line ends at 7.

vectors.name: ride-later-from-height-mismatch
vectors.description: A later ride departs from the previous ride's B.

vectors.name: ride-wrong-stop
vectors.description: A ride's C must be the stop coordinate of its B.

vectors.name: ride-sector-tags-wrong
vectors.description: A ride whose S tag is not computed from its C is invalid.

vectors.name: board-moves
vectors.description: An enter-hyperspace whose C differs from its c is invalid.

vectors.name: board-proof-wrong-seed
vectors.description: The entry proof is seeded by the actual previous event, here a skipped action; one seeded by the spawn is invalid.

vectors.name: board-sector-tags-duplicated
vectors.description: An enter-hyperspace with its S tag twice is invalid.

vectors.name: lookback-ride-through-bracket
vectors.description: Board, play a game, exit, ride: the exit stands for the boarding, so this is the first ride and departs from the station. Its work is seeded by the exit's id.

vectors.name: lookback-ride-seeded-by-boarding
vectors.description: The exit stands in for the boarding only for the look-back rule; a ride seeded by the boarding instead of the exit is invalid.

vectors.name: lookback-ride-through-skipped
vectors.description: A skipped action between boarding and the first ride: the boarding stands before the ride, which is seeded by the skipped id.

vectors.name: lookback-exit-stands-for-hop
vectors.description: The exit stands for the hop before its entry, so the ride has no boarding before it and is invalid.

vectors.name: lookback-later-ride-through-bracket-and-skipped
vectors.description: A game played at a stop and a skipped action, then the next ride: it looks back to the previous ride and departs from its B.

vectors.name: forged-lone-surrogate-ignored
vectors.description: An event under the identity's pubkey whose content holds a lone surrogate, signed earlier than the real hop. A lone surrogate has no UTF-8 encoding, so the event has no canonical serialization: it is not a NIP-01 event and is discarded. A verifier must not stop on it.

vectors.name: forged-string-created-at-ignored
vectors.description: An event whose created_at is a string, signed over its own serialization and earlier than the real hop. NIP-01 requires an integer created_at, so it is discarded and makes no fork.

vectors.name: forged-null-in-tag-ignored
vectors.description: An event whose A tag holds a null, signed over its own serialization and earlier than the real hop. NIP-01 tags are arrays of strings, so it is discarded and makes no fork.

vectors.name: forged-spawn-ignored
vectors.description: A spawn newer than the real one whose sig signs another id is discarded, so it cannot restart the chain.

vectors.name: spawn-tie-larger-id
vectors.description: Two spawns with the same created_at: the one with the larger id is newer and starts the active chain. The hop on the other spawn is an older chain's history and makes no fork, because its e genesis names the other spawn.

vectors.name: other-kind-ignored
vectors.description: A kind 1 event signed by the identity with the links and tags of a hop, signed earlier than the real hop, is not a movement event and makes no fork.

vectors.name: ride-station-tie-lowest-height
vectors.description: With the bound 1, stops 0 and 1 are both at distance 85 from the boarding; the tie goes to the lowest height, so the station is 0 and a first ride from 0 to 1 is valid.

vectors.name: ride-station-tie-not-higher
vectors.description: With the same tie, the station is 0, not 1, so a first ride from 1 to 0 is invalid.

vectors.name: ride-after-board-then-hop
vectors.description: A hop right after boarding moves as usual and cancels the boarding, so a ride after the hop is invalid.

vectors.name: ride-reboard-at-stop
vectors.description: Boarding again while standing at stop 4 makes stop 4 the station (distance 0), and the next ride departs from it.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-c-not-hex
vectors.description: An exit whose c is not a coordinate at all is valid; its c is not checked.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-two-c-tags
vectors.description: An exit with two c tags is valid; its c is not checked.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-sector-tags-from-c
vectors.description: An exit's sector tags are computed from its C, the base position, not from its c.

vectors.name: bracket-region-other-plane
vectors.description: A region on the other plane from the base position is valid: the region is checked for form only.

vectors.name: bracket-region-height-0
vectors.description: A region of height 0, a single point is valid: the region is checked for form only.

vectors.name: bracket-region-height-85
vectors.description: A region of height 85, a whole plane is valid: the region is checked for form only.

vectors.name: board-sector-tags-noncanonical
vectors.description: An enter-hyperspace with a leading zero on its Z tag is invalid.

vectors.name: bracket-enter-sector-tags-noncanonical
vectors.description: An enter-virtual with a leading zero on its Y tag is invalid.

vectors.name: spawn-two-a-tags-spawn-first
vectors.description: Any A tag equal to spawn makes an event a spawn, wherever it stands among the tags. This one is newest, so it starts the active chain, and its second A tag makes it an invalid spawn: the chain is dead at the spawn coordinate, with no fallback to the older chain.

vectors.name: spawn-two-a-tags-spawn-second
vectors.description: Any A tag equal to spawn makes an event a spawn, wherever it stands among the tags. This one is newest, so it starts the active chain, and its second A tag makes it an invalid spawn: the chain is dead at the spawn coordinate, with no fallback to the older chain.

vectors.name: a-tag-bare
vectors.description: A hop whose only A tag is a bare ["A"]: it is an A tag with no value, and invalid.

vectors.name: a-tag-hop-plus-bare
vectors.description: A hop with ["A", "hop"] and a bare ["A"]: two A tags.

vectors.name: a-tag-empty-value
vectors.description: A hop whose A tag is ["A", ""]: an empty value, and invalid.

vectors.name: hop-two-c-tags
vectors.description: A hop with its C tag twice, both copies equal: still invalid.

vectors.name: hop-two-proof-tags-equal
vectors.description: A hop with its valid proof tag twice.

vectors.name: hop-two-proof-tags-good-first
vectors.description: A hop with its valid proof tag and then a garbage one.

vectors.name: hop-two-proof-tags-garbage-first
vectors.description: A hop with a garbage proof tag and then its valid one: the same verdict as with the valid one first.

vectors.name: hop-sector-tags-valueless-copy
vectors.description: A hop with its valid X tag and a valueless ["X"]: two X tags.

vectors.name: hop-two-lowercase-c-tags
vectors.description: A hop with its c tag twice.

vectors.name: hop-proof-valueless
vectors.description: A hop whose only proof tag is a bare ["proof"].

vectors.name: hop-empty-first-e-previous-unlinked
vectors.description: A hop with an empty e previous tag ahead of its real one. Resolution follows the first copy, which names nothing, so the hop is never reached: it is not on the chain, and the chain is the spawn alone, valid.

vectors.name: hop-e-previous-twice
vectors.description: A hop with its e previous tag twice, both copies equal: resolution follows the first, and validity rejects the event.

vectors.name: skip-two-e-genesis-tags
vectors.description: A skipped action with its e genesis tag twice is invalid: on a skipped action the A tag and the e tags are constrained.

vectors.name: bracket-virtual-two-e-previous-tags
vectors.description: A virtual action with its e previous tag twice is invalid: inside a bracket the A tag and the e tags are constrained.

vectors.name: bracket-game-tags-empty-values
vectors.description: A virtual action whose game-defined tags are empty or valueless, including tags whose names base reads elsewhere (c, C, X, proof), is valid: inside a bracket only the A tag and the e tags are constrained.

vectors.name: bracket-exit-two-entry-tags
vectors.description: An exit with its e entry tag twice is invalid.

vectors.name: bracket-region-two-tags
vectors.description: An enter-virtual with its region tag twice is invalid.

vectors.name: bracket-region-plus-valueless
vectors.description: An enter-virtual with its region tag and a bare ["region"]: two region tags.

vectors.name: ride-two-b-tags
vectors.description: A ride with its B tag twice is invalid.

vectors.name: ride-two-as-of-tags
vectors.description: A first ride with its as_of tag twice is invalid.

vectors.name: sidestep-two-mn-tags
vectors.description: A sidestep with its mn tag twice is invalid.

vectors.name: spawn-never-a-link-old
spec: 8.7.3 a spawn is never a link
vectors.description: An older spawn whose e tags name the newest spawn as genesis and a hop in the middle of its chain as previous. A spawn is never a link, so it is not a second next event after that hop: there is no fork, and the chain is valid at its head.

vectors.name: spawn-never-a-link-newest
spec: 8.7.3 a spawn is never a link
vectors.description: The newest spawn carries e tags naming the old chain's spawn and head. It starts the active chain as usual; its e tags are not read, so it neither extends the old chain nor is made invalid by them.

vectors.name: ride-net-tag-unread
vectors.description: A boarding and a ride carrying net tags that name other networks, the ride two of them. The line is Bitcoin mainnet, always; a net tag is informational and never read, so it is not constrained and the ride is valid.

vectors.name: spawn-sector-tags-repeated
vectors.description: The newest spawn carries its S tag twice. It is an invalid newest spawn, so the chain is dead at the spawn coordinate, with no fallback to the older chain.

vectors.name: spawn-c-repeated
vectors.description: The newest spawn carries its C tag twice. It is an invalid newest spawn, so the chain is dead at the spawn coordinate, with no fallback to the older chain.

vectors.name: same-event-twice
vectors.description: The same hop is delivered twice in the input. Forks are counted among distinct events, distinct by id, so a copy of one event is not a fork.

vectors.name: hop-version-1-unlisted
vectors.description: A version 1 hop (its proof the 5.6 proof_hash of this very hop, no mn and no mp) whose id is not on the list. This revision rejects it, so the chain is invalid from it and frozen at the hop before, and the valid version 2 hop after it does not move the identity.

vectors.name: hop-version-1-listed
vectors.description: A version 1 hop whose id is on the test list, then a version 2 hop seeded by its id. The listed hop's proof is accepted and the chain goes on from it.

vectors.name: hop-version-1-listed-proof-not-recomputed
vectors.description: A listed version 1 hop whose proof is well formed but is not its proof_hash. A verifier accepts a listed hop's proof without recomputing it, so the chain is valid. (Only audited hops are ever listed for real; the test list names this one to show that the proof is not recomputed.)

vectors.name: hop-version-1-listed-c-mismatch
vectors.description: A listed version 1 hop whose c is not the previous C. The list waives only the proof: continuity is checked as for any other hop.

vectors.name: hop-version-1-listed-sector-tags-wrong
vectors.description: A listed version 1 hop with a Y tag one sector off. The list waives only the proof: the sector tags are checked as for any other hop.

vectors.name: hop-version-1-listed-two-proof-tags
vectors.description: A listed version 1 hop with its proof tag twice. The list waives the proof's recomputation, never the count and form of the tags.

vectors.name: hop-mn-missing
vectors.description: A hop with a seal and openings but no mn tag, not listed. A missing mn or mp is a hop that does not verify at Level 1, as a missing mn is on an unlisted sidestep.

vectors.name: hop-mp-missing
vectors.description: A hop with a seal and mn but no mp tag, not listed.

vectors.name: hop-two-mn-tags
vectors.description: A hop with its mn tag twice, both copies equal: invalid.

vectors.name: hop-two-mp-tags
vectors.description: A hop with its mp tag twice, both copies equal: invalid.

vectors.name: hop-mn-short
vectors.description: A hop with an mn of 15 hex characters: malformed.

vectors.name: hop-mn-uppercase
vectors.description: A hop with the nonce 10 written as 000000000000000A, whose lowercase form would verify (every nonce meets the price of these hops): malformed.

vectors.name: hop-mp-short
vectors.description: A hop with an mp two characters short of 16 x 128: malformed.

vectors.name: hop-mp-long
vectors.description: A hop with an mp two characters past 16 x 128: malformed.

vectors.name: hop-mp-uppercase
vectors.description: A hop with its mp in uppercase hex: malformed.

vectors.name: hop-residue-flipped
vectors.description: A hop whose first opened residue has its lowest bit flipped. It is no longer hop_n modulo its prime and its leaf no longer hashes to the seal: invalid.

vectors.name: hop-seal-changed
vectors.description: A hop whose seal has its last hex digit changed and whose openings are its own. No opening climbs to that seal: invalid.

vectors.name: hop-any-nonce-at-the-smallest-size
vectors.description: The prover's nonce is 0, and this hop carries nonce 1 with the same seal and openings. With A = 1 every nonce meets the price, and with m = 8 the one block holds every residue, so every sample opens it whichever indices G draws: the hop is valid. A verifier checks the price and the openings, not which nonce the prover found.
